Vault Compass.text:
!

The Vault Compass is a powerful navigation tool designed to assist players throughout the vault. Upon unlock, players gain access to a progression system that allows the compass to attune itself to various targets, making exploration more strategic and rewarding.

By default, the compass still points to the vault's starting portal, but as you progress, you can unlock new targets such as the nearest undiscovered Challenge Room, an uncompleted God Altar, or other special points of interest within the vault.
While inside a vault, players can change the compass's target at any time, though doing so comes at a cost of

(similar to the effect of consuming Vault Fruit).

Through this system, the Vault Compass transforms from a simple navigation tool into a powerful, customizable guide that adapts to each player's goals and exploration style.
